kata.name: Prototype weak lens: clone intrinsic drift — the clone-image equation finds it, the conventional equality test finds it too
kata.series_verdict: pre-registered: Prototype has no proven equivalence in ploeh §6; the clone-image lens is expected to buy zero unique detections (parity)

expected.detail: the weak lens is the equation clone∘intrinsic = source∘intrinsic (the clone preserves intrinsic value); the seeded fault gives Copy row 0 a clone whose intrinsic value is t2 while its source holds t1. The scripted conventional test compares the clone and source fields for every copy, so the detection is parity.

commands: python3 prototype/weak_lens_set_baseline.py --assert  # exit 0: scripted conventional test matches the pre-registered detections
cargo run -q -p catherine-cli -- check fixtures/katas/weak-lens-set/prototype-fault-clone-drift.ct.json --json  # exit 3, 1 findings
cargo test -p catherine-ledger --test weak_lens_set_kata  # frozen evidence test

comparison.conventional_baseline: scripted Prototype test: for every copy, clone.intrinsic = source.intrinsic; covers both copy rows

expressibility_gap.invariant: aliasing and mutation independence (deep vs shallow copy)
expressibility_gap.why: static path equality sees declared values only; later mutation of a shared subobject and clone aliasing have no representation

discrepancies: ploeh-grounding.md §6 lists these patterns as HYPOTHESIZED candidates, not proven equivalences; this slice records parity or a null result and does not upgrade any of them.
procedure: 1. control first: validate the near-floor control's empty unique set and killed verdict before any positive is read.
2. probe arm: cargo run -q -p catherine-cli -- check <fixture> --json; findings recorded verbatim.
3. baseline arm: python3 prototype/weak_lens_set_baseline.py --assert; detections are the pre-registered element names.
4. unique = probe elements - baseline elements; the element vocabulary is fixed in fixtures/katas/weak-lens-set/README.md.
5. verdict: empty unique with an expressible lens => killed (parity); an unexpressible lens with zero findings => killed with the gap recorded (null result).
